title: spermacoce xanthophylla
intro: Spermacoce xanthophylla, commonly known as Yellow Beggartick, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, colds, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Spermacoce xanthophylla include its antimicrobial and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
